summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG spanning authored levels, player-specific rooms, and shared destinations. `templates/player.js` composes player behaviors; place simulations and scenes provide local worlds while shared scripts own combat, NPCs, loot, UI, avatar presentation, and progression. Level 26's SS Fun quest now follows Phoebe to a stowaway's bedroll, then points to the Bonus Room Teleport Station.
places: places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall with shops, landmarks, simulated staff/shoppers, arcade games, and Glow Up Salon styling stations.
places/main (3D) - authored Level 0/Lobby maze; sim generates furniture and loot, safe rooms, shifting walls, creature ecology, route guidance, Kade, and Zenith's sealed far-east breach.
places/level01 (3D) - Level 0.1 Zenith Station: versioned station/gallery, doors, breakables, bots/hazards, climate rooms, flight-recorder quest, and drone-refilled posts.
places/intake (3D) + places/tutorial0 (solo ephemeral 3D) - bedroom character-creation/waking space and authored tutorial route with staged encounter and HALOGEN.
places/level1, level2, level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams, and Locked; Dina's camp and M.E.G./B.N.T.G. quests, Refrigerator Paradise operations, and The Edges.
places/level3, gamma, level4, level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office, and Terror Hotel; residents, hazards, office/home systems, Boiler Room rats, and library ladders.

places/level6, level7, level10, level11, level12, level26 (3D) - Lights Out, Thalassophobia, Bumper Crop, Infinite City, Matrix, and SS Fun =) liner; Level 26 has Cabin 23, Phoebe, wet shoeprints, and the new stowaway bedroll.
places/debug, spamton and other configured places (3D) - debug mannequin/body gallery and switch pad, Spamton fight space, plus auxiliary routes.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, player/camera setup, and ordered behavior composition; quick actions feed player behaviors.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - place settings, authored placements, and local generated/ticked behavior; main sim owns Level 0 generation.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js - title/pause, character creation, arrival, tutorial routing, first-arrival cutscene, BODIES toggle, and solo pause time-scale.
places/intake/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/intake-geo.js + scripts/lib/intro-cut.js - bedroom and waking sequence; tutorial scene and tut0 scripts own tutorial route/beats.

places/level1/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/dina-diary.js + scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - Dina camp/diary entry and main-quest progression; Level 26 scene hosts Cabin 23, Phoebe, and stow-nest interactions.
scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js + scripts/ui.js - camera, third-person toggle, HUD and panels; scripts/loot-ui.js renders HALOGEN inventory and quick slots.
scripts/quest-marker.js + scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - per-player journal, tracking, objective resolution and markers; folds legacy quest state into shared records.
places/level12/sim.js + places/level12/cells/*.scene - versioned Matrix room/void construction and shared ticking ritual clock; avatar art/scripts and tools build/validate presentation assets.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - shared/solo room IDs, Bonus Room and home destinations/crossings, and last-level names; routing and hub handlers use it.
scripts/lib/loot.js + items.js + weapons.js/weapons.yml - common loot spawning, container rolls, remains, place pools, weapon definitions/rarity and variants.
scripts/lib/build-piece.js + breakables.yml + furniture.yml - canonical build specs/models shared by B-mode and home reconstruction; CRT TV builds attach scripts/built-tv.js.
scripts/lib/screen.js - derived read-only screen classifier and wrist gates; scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - quest records/tracking and resolving place/id or coordinate goals.
scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/maze0path.js - seeded Level 0 cell/zone/wall/pit/pillar layout and open-point/BFS doorway steering for place simulation and creature navigation.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml + wardrobe.yml + wardrobe-split.yml + critter data + scripts/lib/critter-model.js - clothing loot/armor, deterministic looks, species/head/hair presentation and wardrobe fitting.
scripts/lib/body3.js + scripts/lib/data/combat-anims.yml + scripts/lib/knock.js - shared combat animation channels for player and M.E.G. agents; knock handling serves melee and enemy kick knockdowns.

scripts/lib/nav.js - shared builtin/nav path wrapper/cache and per-tick budget for M.E.G. agents, Level 5 staff and Level 6.1 staff; scripts/lib/sight.js clearSight is reused by combatants for melee line-of-sight.
notableExports: scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, gateItems, rollLock, rollCash, rollItem, spawnCrate and Level 2 container/loot helpers; scripts/lib/weapons.js - baseOf, variantOf, rollVariant, rarityIdx, rarityCap, default.
scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update, looseSpent; scripts/kick.js - onInput, kickSnap, kickEnd, update.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, onInput, hitTarget, and fishing handlers.
scripts/lib/quick-items.js - quickItems, assignQuick; builds inventory/quick-slot choices and validates assignment of carried usable items.
scripts/lib/screen.js - WRIST, screen, canOpen, openWrist; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom.
scripts/critter.js - update, onInput and face/blink handlers; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - body/face/head/spec and wardrobe fitting/restyling helpers.
scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, react3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands, stance; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.
scripts/lib/nav.js - NAV, navBudget, navPath; scripts/lib/sight.js - clearSight; scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - DINA, CAMP, DCUT_LEN, PAGE1, PAGE2, PAGES, dinaTick; scripts/l26-stow-nest.js - ears.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, money, appearance, combat/rewards, level access, saved place/position, wakeAtSave restoration, and heat/cold meters.

scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - Dina progression fields dinaQ, dinaDiary and dcut; scripts/lib/quests.js - player.state.quests, qtrack and qdone; quest-marker.js folds legacy quest state into active records.
scripts/lib/level1-quests.js - per-player rationsQ/waterQ steps, route and failed-check flags, rewards, faction/karma changes and objective markers; journal records go through lib/quests.js.

scripts/lib/level8-quests.js, level10-quests.js, level11-quests.js, level21-quests.js, zenith-quest.js and l5-goggles.js - level-specific quest step keys and turn-in/reward effects synchronized with journal records/markers.
scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js - per-player kick rolls/cooldowns, carried prop/body IDs, held-body grip, and throw/carry session fields; target heldBy/down state controls hold/release.
scripts/lib/loose.js - arms matched props with state.loose/mat/hp/maxHp and owns broke/act effects; per-player session.loose tracks kicked/thrown item flights until impact.
scripts/lib/knock.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - foe attributes/weight and shared down/stagger knock outcomes; enemy managers retain AI state and write player-targeting sneakTarget.

scripts/lib/quick-items.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.quickSlots maps digit slots to item IDs; assignQuick validates unique carried items and player quick-use executes the action; l26-phoebe-early writes player.state.freeze for the cutscene.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors: locomotion/player/foe-steps, swim/climb, interact/grab/kick/rest/mahjong/talk/build/noclip/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/fights/horde/critter/menu/hub/view3/quest-marker.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes aimPt and ranged aimPitch → player.js ballistics.
scripts/routing.js accepts permitted requested rooms; otherwise scripts/lib/hub.js soloRoom selects the player's solo Backrooms room and bonus overflow IDs.

Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js; START enters intake for creation or bonus for completed characters; wardrobe close runs intro-cut then tutorial0 unless t0Done; menu UI renders on menuOpen and solo pause sets place.timeScale.
scripts/main-menu.js BODIES action or debug pad → world.state.bodyStyle (menu also persists player.state.bodyStyle); root sim.js/critter.js select avatar and restyle occupants via critter-model.js.
Human avatar look/state.wear → critter-model.js humanBody + humanMorph and wardrobe-split.yml; visible Ward_ outfit pieces become tinted morphed skinned children using cloth_ material slots.

scripts/lib/hub.js toHub/toSolo → room/place crossings and roomHop distinguishes intentional crossings from launch/resume; hubOffer → hub-ui.js and mall counters write shop/food state for handlers and UI.
Found loot search → scripts/interact.js calls loot.gateItems for non-storage/non-NPC contents; rarity caps are 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; weapon variants roll through weapons.js.

Player and M.E.G. combat handlers → scripts/lib/body3.js stance/swing/fire/aim/reload → combat-anims.yml; lib/stats.js and ballistics.js apply weapon skill/handling; meg-agent.js, partygoers.js and smilers.js use lib/sight.js clearSight to gate melee hits.

Level 0 main sim → maze.js seeded geometry/cell helpers and level0-moments.js; moments.js handles placed moments; smilers/lurkers use maze0path and sneak.crouchMul while hunter managers publish pursuit cues.

scripts/lib/quests.js writes player.state.quests/qtrack/qdone; level quest handlers and quest-marker.js sync records, resolve goals through quest-mark.js, then draw player-only markers and journal rows. Dina steps 5/6 point to l26d-stow-nest and bonus-ctr-station; nest ears search sets step 6.

HALOGEN inventory in scripts/loot-ui.js sends quickSlot/quickAssign actions → scripts/player.js + lib/quick-items.js update player.state.quickSlots; Phoebe trigger writes state.freeze → humanoid-locomotion stops translation and camera holds yaw/pitch until expiry.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml + places/bonus/sim.js + scripts/mall-shopper.js + scripts/salon-stylist.js/scripts/salon-ui.js - authored mall shops/landmarks and simulated mall life; salon chairs queue sitters.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/build.js + places/home11/sim.js - per-piece models/dimensions with common placement, persistence and rebuild path; CRT TV builds attach screen, sound and glow.

places/level01/sim.js + scripts/zenith-geo.js + scripts/zenith-breach-geo.js + scripts/zenith-door.js + scripts/zenith-bots.js + scripts/zenith-hatch.js + scripts/zenith-flicker.js + scripts/zenith-drones.js + scripts/zenith-use.js - Zenith station geometry and interactive/hazard systems.
places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js + scripts/lib/l4-people.js/level4-people.yml - office layout/fixtures and resident schedules, roles and home claims.
scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - Level 5 per-NPC role/dialogue/look/routine on shared meg-agent behavior.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter/faces/hair/model/wardrobe data + art/human-cloth/* + art/human-head/* + art/human-hair/build.py - deterministic avatar looks, fitted wardrobe meshes and validation/build tooling.

scripts/lib/data/combat-anims.yml + scripts/lib/body3.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/critter.js + scripts/meg-agent.js - shared human combat/gait, idles, head tracking, fidgets, expressions, and dialogue.

scripts/lib/nav.js + scripts/meg-agent.js + scripts/l5-staff.js + scripts/l61-staff.js - independent NPC walkers share exact-endpoint/options-aware, short-lived path cache and query budget; retry/repath when blocked. Level 26 quest trail pairs Phoebe with l26-stow-nest search.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - exports procedural balloon geometry/skeleton/collider but Level 26 scene placements and barrage use uploaded models instead.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - header marks it as a temporary hair lane test rig; no tree/package references found.
migrationNotes: Bonus Room uses shared room/place bonus; soloRoom(userId) names each player's Backrooms room and overflow mall rooms use bonus-N IDs. Teleport Station travel derives from savePlace; level01 is not a solo home.

Found-item rarity gates apply to found weapon tokens; search gating excludes storage and NPC containers. Weapon IDs may include a ~variant suffix; baseOf handles kind lookup and W[k] resolves the full variant.

Level 0 place.state.momentsV is 7: migration deletes old tagged moment entities before relaying them. Selected Level 0 furniture/clutter has explicit visibleRange and disabled shadows; preserve interaction tags/state alongside placements.

Level 12 ritual tuning is in scripts/lib/data/level12.yml: sit/hour/tol are seconds (45/180/12 currently); r12.back is a ctx.now() millisecond timestamp and the exit requires the return-door attempt within tol seconds of one hour.

scripts/lib/data/sneak.yml tunes crouch visibility and awareness; crouch still/moving, dark and flashlight multipliers combine in crouchMul. Hunters publish player state.sneakTarget while pursuing and clear it when sight is lost.

Level 26 wet shoeprint planes are authored scene placements; Phoebe's early trigger freezes the player facing away for 13.6 s and advances Dina step 4→5. Searching l26d-stow-nest can sequence-break step 5 and advances to step 6 at bonus-ctr-station; lib/nav.js caps path searches at 3 per tick and caches successful exact requests for 500 ms.
